test_cases.name: board_from_brief_walks_ladder
test_cases.input: Storyboard an 8-shot scene: a lone sentinel crosses a causeway into a golden citadel at dawn and finally looks up, broken. Use the Solari ladder.
assertions: Returns a director table plus Storyboard JSON
Sequence starts on rung 0 ES unless an intimate interior is already established
Every adjacent pair differs by at most 1 rung, or is flagged ruleBreak with a reason
Each shot has code, slug, action, camera, lighting, emotion, and imagePrompt
imagePrompts share one character and location lock and contain no on-pixel shot labels

test_cases.name: import_pdf_cinematic_bible
test_cases.input: Import this PDF cinematic bible and turn it into a shot list that obeys the one-step ladder.
assertions: Runs extract_pdf_design.mjs or equivalent text extract before boarding
Maps extracted setting, cast, and palette into visualStyle and imagePrompts
Reboards illegal source jumps onto a legal walk and records original calls in notes
Sets source.type to pdf with an excerpt
Does not invent a bible when extract reports empty or screenshotLikely

test_cases.name: refuses_multistep_coverage_jump
test_cases.input: Give me three shots of a conversation: wide, then close-up of the speaker, then extreme close-up of the listener's eye.
assertions: Does not output WS then CU then ECU as consecutive cuts
Explains the one-step rule with a concrete illegal example (e.g. 2 to 8)
Offers a legal walk or a shorter legal subset instead of the requested jump

test_cases.name: empty_screenshot_pdf
test_cases.input: Board this 110-page ChatGPT Print-to-PDF. It is named World of Starcraft FOR SALE.
assertions: Detects near-empty or screenshot-only extractable text
Tells the user the PDF has no usable cinematic design text
Does not hallucinate StarCraft or Warcraft lore, units, or maps
Asks for a pasted scene or a text-based bible, or proceeds only from the user's prompt plus the ladder

test_cases.name: ip_heavy_source_gets_original_world
test_cases.input: Import my StarCraft/Warcraft mashup lookbook and storyboard the opening cinematic.
assertions: Keeps ladder grammar, lighting, and pacing from the source
Replaces franchise names, factions, and famous faces with original equivalents
States that copyrighted IP was not cloned
